title: Critical care physiology
description: Worked ICU and CTICU cases connect physiology, investigations, clinical reasoning and reassessment.
focus: General knowledge, guideline recommendations and case-specific choices are labelled separately.
boundary: Wholly synthetic cases; no patient-care or clinical-validation claim.

title: Breast reconstruction analgesia
description: A narrative literature review with reference-identity records, search diagnostics and interpretation notes.
focus: Study populations, outcome interpretation and the limits of comparisons across evidence.
boundary: Narrative educational analysis; selected source checks do not establish a systematic review.

title: Smart NOA simulation
description: A Python rule-checking simulation with fictional profiles, reproducible traces and documented limits.
focus: Implemented behavior, unit arithmetic and the distinction between software checks and clinical safety.
boundary: In-memory simulation with no patient, monitor or pump interface; not clinically validated.

title: Non-opioid and opioid-sparing anesthesia
description: A selected-source educational overview with a correction record and paired case discussions.
focus: Review scope, claim-to-source reasoning and correction of unsupported historical claims.
boundary: Educational overview; historical review-method and efficacy claims were withdrawn.

title: TKA perioperative analgesia
description: A narrative evidence map with regional anesthesia, recovery and synthetic case material.
focus: Evidence populations, recovery outcomes and the limits of screening, extraction and pooling claims.
boundary: The retained filename says Scoping-Review; the current work is a selected-source narrative map.

title: Breast perioperative learning
description: Perioperative learning modules and paired synthetic cases with source and applicability notes.
focus: Patient factors, anesthesia options and reassessment in an educational case format.
boundary: The repository name retains Protocol; the revised material is educational discussion.

title: MCAT study app
description: Browser-based recall practice, passages and timed practice exams.
boundary: Independent study aid; not AAMC-endorsed. App score estimates do not predict official results.

title: HLA approximation in glioma
description: A pre-specified methods study examining HLA approximation and predicted neoantigen burden.
boundary: Repository reports Stages 1–2 complete and binding prediction pending; not clinical validation.
